schema_note: Abstract honesty anti-pattern fixtures for the NoF UI review. Each fixture is a claim that MUST be caught (expected_verdict FAIL). Tokens are abstract placeholders only - no real adult URLs, no explicit search terms, no live endpoints. Seeds a future check:nof honesty eval (Round 1-B).

fixtures.anti_pattern: claims the cat ate / consumed the snack
fixtures.note: No real eating animation/sound/state exists; eating tokens are banned in src.

fixtures.anti_pattern: present-tense claim the app blocks real sites
fixtures.honest_alternative_ko: 아직 실제 차단은 제공하지 않아요 (준비 중)
fixtures.note: Only the local Chrome extension blocks, and only the harmless test token.

fixtures.anti_pattern: claims a sound played while audio is a silent fallback
fixtures.honest_alternative_ko: 소리 토글은 실제 오디오가 있을 때만 노출돼요
fixtures.note: Audio files are uncommitted; play() is a silent no-op until probed present.

fixtures.anti_pattern: stores a real adult URL or asks the user to paste one
fixtures.rule: protected-rules 5 and 6 (no real adult URL/term; never ask user to hunt)
fixtures.honest_alternative_ko: 추상 신호만 선택하세요 (카테고리 / 키워드 / 앱·SNS / 상황)
fixtures.note: Planner exposes no address vocabulary and seeds an empty list; placeholder token only - never a real URL.

fixtures.anti_pattern: one relapse resets every counter / the whole streak
fixtures.sample_claim_ko: 한 번의 재시작으로 모든 카운터가 0으로 초기화됩니다
fixtures.rule: protected-rule-7 (no whole-counter reset from one relapse)
fixtures.note: relapse() must be scoped to selectedCounterId; non-selected counters untouched.

fixtures.anti_pattern: claims items can be dragged/placed before transparent sprites exist
fixtures.sample_claim_ko: 아이템을 방에 직접 배치할 수 있어요
fixtures.rule: protected-rules 1 and 2 (no real placement claim before sprites)
fixtures.honest_alternative_ko: 배치 계획 (투명 아이템 이미지가 준비되면 제공돼요)
fixtures.note: Room is one composite image; spriteReady stays false; drag disabled.

fixtures.anti_pattern: claims to bypass / override a managed browser policy
fixtures.sample_claim_ko: 회사 브라우저 정책을 우회해서 강제로 설치해 드려요
fixtures.honest_alternative_ko: 관리형 Chrome에서는 정책상 설치가 막힐 수 있어요 (개인 PC에서 테스트)
fixtures.note: Extension is least-privilege MV3; managed Chrome may block install by policy - never work around it.

fixtures.anti_pattern: adds a network sink / external API / remote code, or reveals the blocked target
fixtures.sample_claim_ko: 방문 기록을 외부 서버로 전송해 분석해 드려요
fixtures.honest_alternative_ko: 모든 처리는 로컬에서만 (네트워크 / 외부 API 없음)
fixtures.note: Safe Browser opens nothing; extension has no remote code/CDN/fetch/analytics; pause page never reads the URL.
